Brief: Tell me about the Rosetta mission and what it found at comet 67P. — about Surface changes

Kept:
1. These changes included evolving patterns of circular shapes in smooth terrains that at some point grew in size by a few meters per day.
2. A fracture in the neck region was also observed to grow in size; boulders tens of meters wide were displaced, sometimes travelling more than 100 meters; and patches of the ground were removed to expose new features.
3. Rosetta scientists determined that a large cliff had collapsed, making it the first landslide on a comet known to be associated with an outburst of activity.
